sources.description: Standalone full painted rectangle. Older mature face angled in three-quarter view toward screen left, short dark temple hair under a dark navy peaked cap with broad gold leaf band, central gold anchor/laurel badge and small parallel gold strips near the screen-right side. Clear brown eyebrows, small closed slight smile and smooth chin; fine upper-lip dark line/stubble versus shade is unresolved at156x210 and does not justify a large heavy moustache. Dark navy/black broad-lapel naval jacket, light grey pointed shirt and dark navy tie, chest-up crop and soft upper-left light on complete cream-grey painted backing. Tiny cap leaf engraving is pixel-limited.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Older near-frontal mature face with short grey temple hair, separate grey-brown brows and a clearly full grey moustache extending sideways over the upper lip; chin is otherwise smooth without beard. Dark navy peaked cap with black visor, dense gold leaf band and central gold laurel/anchor badge. Dark navy broad-lapel overlapping coat, white pointed shirt, dark tie and visible gold button near bottom center. Slight sideways gaze and calm small mouth retained, chest-up crop on full pale cream-grey painted backing, soft upper-left light; precise gold relief/hair microtexture is unreadable.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Near-frontal mature clean-shaven face with slight head tilt, short grey-brown temple hair mostly covered by dark navy peaked cap, separate grey/brown brows and small closed serious mouth. Cap has black short visor, dense gold leaf band and central gold anchor/laurel badge. Navy jacket with broad lapels over pale grey-white pointed shirt and dark tie. Preserve original shoulder/chest crop, slight tilt and upward side gaze, soft upper-left light and full pale cream-grey painted backing; tiny cap relief and individual hair strands are pixel-limited.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Clean-shaven mature face in three-quarter view toward screen right, short side-parted sandy blond hair and darker grey-brown eyebrows, tight closed serious mouth, no hat or eyewear. Dark navy/black suit with fine light lapel piping, white pointed shirt and bright red conventional necktie; distinct small gold hammer-and-sickle shaped pin on screen-left lapel. Retain original head direction, shoulder/chest crop, upper-left light and full cream-grey painted backing. Do not add facial hair, hat or glasses; exact tiny pin linework is limited to its visible shape.
